description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CGI is seeking an Angular Developer to modernize user interfaces integrated with the Momentum suite supporting government financials. The role develops and maintains Angular and Java applications, creates custom modules, integrates systems, and collaborates with developers, engineers, and business analysts to deliver client solutions.
Angular Developer building and maintaining Angular and Java applications, custom modules, and system integrations

Responsibilities:
• Developing and maintaining applications, creating custom modules, and integrating systems using Angular and related technologies
• You will collaborate closely with fellow developers, engineers, and business analysts to design, develop, test, and deploy solutions that meet the needs of our clients
• Responsibilities include developing and maintaining both new and existing Angular and Java based applications
• Whether troubleshooting a software defect, enhancing an existing application, or developing a new solution, you should be able to delve into frameworks and libraries to deliver coherent solutions aligned with the overall architecture of the application landscape

Requirements:
• Academic background in computer science, computer engineering, or a similar major with extensive computer-based or technical content
• 1+ years of relevant development experience, with a focus on Angular development
• Experience with a mixture of AngularJS 1.X, Angular 2.0+, TypeScript, Spring, SpringBoot, Java
• Oracle SQL/PostgreSQL competency
• Experience with GIT source control
• Ability to bring projects to completion in a timely manner
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
• Ability to learn and understand the nature of business
• Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
• Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment

Preferred:
• Skills in HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap
• Familiarity with SOAP/REST
• Knowledge of Momentum Financials/Acquisitions
• Skills in HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap
• Experience working under Agile methodology
• Familiarity with JIRA
• ERP software experience
• Effective communication with non-technical staff and members of interdisciplinary teams
